policy.statement: Rule-based rights ledger. Exceptions carry status=hold with rationale, required action, owner and evidence. This ledger never clears a rights-gated row; final rights disposition is a human gate (handoff 05 checkpoint 2).

rules.scope: kind in {article-candidate, structured-doc, fragment, navigation} (Markdown/YAML docs)
rules.rationale: ThirdPartyNotices.md at the pinned revision grants documentation and other content under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE).

rules.scope: code content (and the LICENSE-CODE / LICENSE grant texts themselves)
rules.rationale: ThirdPartyNotices.md grants any code in the repository under the MIT License (see LICENSE-CODE). LICENSE-CODE holds the MIT text; LICENSE holds the CC BY 4.0 legal text and is treated as the grant document pair.

Handoff 02: review each screenshot, icon, dataset, download and cross-repo fragment. The blanket CC BY 4.0 grant is not assumed to cover per-asset branding/attribution questions; asset-level clearance is pending.
Content absent from the sparse checkout: no bytes or hash, no evaluation possible.

rules.scope: kind in {redirect, repository-control, support} (functional/config text retained, not published as editorial content)
rules.rationale: Textual repository content covered by the CC BY 4.0 'documentation and other content' grant; consumed for publishing behaviour, not republished as editorial pages.

rules.rightsState: ThirdPartyNotices.md -> cc-by-4.0-docs; LICENSE and LICENSE-CODE -> mit-code
rules.rationale: These files ARE the grant documents; they are retained and drive attribution obligations.
Embedded validation footers carry all-rights-reserved notices; repository-level CC BY 4.0 cannot be applied until the notice scope is resolved by the human rights gate.
rules.evidence: handoff 02_FABRIC_KNOWLEDGE_MAP.md §Rights and known exceptions; file inspection@774592ea

rules.scope: any row with crossTreeHints > 0 or cross-repo include references (~/../<repo>/...)
rules.rationale: Cross-tree references and cross-repo includes are dependency and rights holds until a pinned+cleared dependency exists (handoff 02). Recorded as explicit exception rows; never cleared by this registry.

rules.scope: unavailable/special and external dependencies discovered by scan (dep: rows)
rules.rationale: Unpinned external targets cannot carry a rights decision; Microsoft Learn service terms are separate from the Git reuse grant.
